_comment: Back-end families, how to recognise them from what the Cinder driver reports, and which pairs have been verified. A family that is not listed here is unsupported. Add a family or a verification here (and its test); the engine is not changed.
method: Cinder retype with migration_policy on-demand, sent through the OpenStack APIs. Whether the drivers move the data themselves or Cinder copies it through a cinder-volume host is their decision and OpenMove cannot see it; the post-check reads the result.
staged_method: The staged method (copy, sync, recheck, cutover with the snapshot history rebuilt) is not built. Class C volumes are held back.

verified.where: the OpenMove lab (DevStack 2025.1, two LVM back-ends)
verified.covers: classes A: detached, attached and boot volumes, the way back, a retype that Cinder silently undoes, failures of the API, the volume service and the halt button
